name: SuggestedPostDeclined
description: Describes a service message about the rejection of a suggested post.

fields.name: suggested_post_message
fields.description: Message containing the suggested post. Note that the [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message) object in this field will not contain the _reply\_to\_message_ field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: comment
fields.description: Comment with which the post was declined
